findings.claim: The generated-artifact parity gate ignores newly generated untracked files, allowing incomplete committed API or evidence output to pass.
findings.evidence: git diff reports tracked-file changes but does not report untracked files created by docs:api or docs:evidence.
findings.suggested_fix: After regeneration, also fail on scoped untracked files using git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all.

findings.claim: The packed API fingerprint does not identify the tarballs that produced the documentation.
findings.evidence: The fingerprint hashes only inventory entries whose tarballIntegrity values are null for all twelve packages, so different tarball contents with unchanged metadata produce the same fingerprint.
findings.suggested_fix: Hash each packed tarball's bytes, record its SHA-256 or SRI in the inventory, and include those content hashes in the fingerprint.
